claim: The sample ledger has two accounts, three entries, and one balance check; reset restores it and exit discards it without mixing with personal records.
sandbox: Fresh browser context with a seeded personal ledger; enter /?demo=1, mutate and reset sample data, exit, then assert no demo database or demo: keys and byte-for-byte unchanged personal records and preferences.

claim: Records an entry and closes an exact balance check.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; add an entry, close a matching check, and assert its history.

claim: Requires and records a note when a balance check differs.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; submit a different balance without and then with a note, and assert history.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo, wait for service worker, go offline, and reload.

claim: Exports every ledger entry as CSV without opening balances or balance-check history.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; download CSV and assert the header plus one row per sample entry.

claim: Imports valid CSV entry rows into named accounts.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; import one row and assert its note and exact changed balance.

claim: CSV imports treat negative amounts as spending and positive amounts as money received.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; import one negative and one positive row, then assert both entries and their combined balance change.

claim: Validates every CSV row before saving any imported entry.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; import one valid and one invalid row, then assert neither was saved.

claim: Encrypts the backup on this device without ledger cleartext, stored passwords, or third-party requests.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; download a password backup and assert its encrypted envelope omits sample cleartext.

claim: A full encrypted backup restores all accounts, entries, and balance checks.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; export, erase, restore, and assert both accounts, an entry, and a check.

claim: Only the backup password can open an encrypted backup; there is no recovery key.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; reject a wrong password and restore with the original password.

claim: Deletes an individual entry and offers Undo.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; create, delete, undo, and assert the entry and balance return.

claim: Erases all accounts, entries, and checks from this browser after confirmation.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; confirm erase and inspect all three IndexedDB stores.

claim: Installs as a standalone web app and shows an action when an update is ready.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; inspect the manifest and mock an installed worker update through the visible reload action.

claim: Records remain in this browser; no bank login, sync, third-party font, or third-party script is required.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow; assert only product-origin requests, local IndexedDB, and no login input.

claim: Account names stay unique regardless of case or repeated spaces.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; try a case and whitespace variant of an existing account name, then assert it is rejected.

claim: Stores each supported amount in the currency's smallest unit.
sandbox: Fresh /demo ledger; create accounts in INR, USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, and JPY, then assert exact stored units and the maximum USD amount displayed.
